title: Fill Vrat Katha content and fix Krishna Leela TTS narration

requirements.text: Populate complete Vrat Katha content for all major vratas in the static katha data (frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts). Each Vrat Katha must include: full Hindi story text (kathaHindi), full English story text (kathaEnglish), correct category set to 'Vrat', deity name, title, and all required metadata fields. Include at minimum the following vratas: Ekadashi Vrat Katha, Somvar (Monday) Shiv Vrat Katha, Mangalvar (Tuesday) Hanuman Vrat Katha, Budh (Wednesday) Vrat Katha, Brihaspativar (Thursday) Vrat Katha, Shukravar (Friday) Santoshi Mata Vrat Katha, Shanivar (Saturday) Shani Vrat Katha, Karva Chauth Vrat Katha, Teej Vrat Katha, Navratri Vrat Katha, Satyanarayan Vrat Katha (complete version), Pradosh Vrat Katha, Ganesh Chaturthi Vrat Katha, Ahoi Ashtami Vrat Katha, Hartalika Teej Vrat Katha, Jivitputrika Vrat Katha, Vat Savitri Vrat Katha, Surya Shashti (Chhath) Vrat Katha, Nirjala Ekadashi Vrat Katha, and Purnima Vrat Katha. All katha text must be meaningful, complete religious narratives — not placeholder or truncated text.

quotes: Fill all again there is no vrat katha

acceptanceCriteria: The Kathayen page with 'Vrat' category tab shows at least 20 Vrat Kathas
Each Vrat Katha card displays the correct title, deity, and category badge
Opening any Vrat Katha detail page shows full Hindi and English story text — no empty or placeholder content
Hindi/English language toggle works correctly for all Vrat Kathas

requirements.text: Fix the AI text-to-speech (TTS) narration feature in the Krishna Leela katha detail page (frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx). The useSpeechNarration hook (frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts) must be correctly invoked with the currently displayed katha text (Hindi or English based on the active language toggle). Ensure: (1) the narration play button is visible and enabled for Krishna Leela kathas, (2) clicking play triggers speech synthesis using the Web Speech API, (3) pause, resume, and stop controls work as expected, (4) when the language is toggled while narration is active, the current narration stops and restarts in the new language, (5) appropriate error handling is shown if the browser does not support speech synthesis.

quotes: narration text to speech ai option not working in krishna leela

acceptanceCriteria: Narration play button is visible on Krishna Leela katha detail pages
Clicking play begins audio narration of the displayed katha text
Pause, resume, and stop buttons function correctly during narration
Switching language (Hindi/English) while narrating stops the current speech and restarts in the new language
No console errors related to speech synthesis when using the narration feature
A user-facing message is shown if the browser does not support Web Speech API

requirements.text: Ensure the backend (backend/main.mo) katha storage and seed data includes complete Krishna Leela katha entries and all 20 Vrat Kathas with full text fields populated (hindText, englishText, category, deity, title, isApproved = true). If the backend katha list is empty or incomplete, seed it with the same content defined in the frontend static data so that the Kathayen page shows all stories when the backend is available.

quotes: Fill all again there is no vrat katha

acceptanceCriteria: Backend returns at least 20 Vrat Kathas and multiple Krishna Leela kathas when queried
All returned kathas have non-empty hindText and englishText fields
All returned kathas have isApproved set to true so they display in the frontend listing

constraints: Do not modify any file under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Do not remove or replace the useSpeechNarration hook — fix its integration instead
All katha content must be authentic Hindu religious narratives in proper Hindi and English
nonGoals: Adding new app sections or pages beyond Kathayen and KathaDetail
Integrating external TTS APIs — use the existing Web Speech API via useSpeechNarration
Changing the overall app design or color theme
Adding payment or premium subscription features
